Not just being good at my job—I genuinely believe I’m meant to revolutionize how people communicate, like I’m on the brink of some breakthrough that will change the field worldwide. I sometimes think government agencies or big universities are quietly following my work, waiting for me to “realize my potential.”

I’ve had a few periods, maybe a week or so at a time, where I get unusually energized and talkative. I stay up late planning projects, feel super confident, spend more than I should on books and software. But those phases come and go. The belief that I’m this kind of “chosen” language expert never really goes away—whether I’m wired and upbeat or just having an ordinary day.

I still go to work, see my clients, manage the house with my husband. I’m functioning fine, but a lot of my thoughts and decisions are wrapped around this idea that I’m destined for something huge.
